answer: One delta firebreak sector per identity, locked with a 95-credit bond. Each epoch it files an ember-watch log of passes, ember spots, and sector key. A gale table sets minimum passes for that wind; a delta ledger publishes each log hash for recomputation. A log short of the gale minimum or a reused sector key burns the bond. Fees rise per funder: first 38, k-th 38+4(k-1), 1000th 4034, 1000 fakes pay 2,036,000 plus 95,000 locked. A rented-watch ring fails because sector key, epoch, and gale reading bind each log. An honest watcher pays 38 once and recovers the bond after a clean epoch.
